query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `ruleApplications` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
  `ruleId` int NOT NULL,
  `projectId` int,
  `userId` int NOT NULL,
  `appliedAt` timestamp DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `status` varchar(20) DEFAULT 'active',
  `isCompliant` boolean,
  `complianceNotes` text,
  `updatedAt` timestamp DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `idx_ruleId` (`ruleId`),
  KEY `idx_projectId` (`projectId`),
  KEY `idx_userId` (`userId`),
  FOREIGN KEY (`ruleId`) REFERENCES `rulesLibrary` (`id`)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `customRules` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
  `ruleCode` varchar(100) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  `name` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `description` text NOT NULL,
  `category` varchar(50) NOT NULL,
  `jurisdiction` varchar(100),
  `keywords` text,
  `creatorId` int NOT NULL,
  `creatorName` varchar(255),
  `creatorCredentials` text,
  `authorizedBy` int,
  `authorizedAt` timestamp,
  `isActive` boolean DEFAULT true,
  `createdAt` timestamp DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updatedAt` timestamp DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `idx_ruleCode` (`ruleCode`),
  KEY `idx_creatorId` (`creatorId`)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `ruleAuditTrail` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
  `action` varchar(50) NOT NULL,
  `ruleId` int,
  `ruleCode` varchar(100),
  `ruleType` varchar(20),
  `projectId` int,
  `userId` int NOT NULL,
  `userName` varchar(255),
  `userCredentials` text,
  `details` text,
  `ipAddress` varchar(45),
  `userAgent` text,
  `createdAt` timestamp DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `idx_ruleCode` (`ruleCode`),
  KEY `idx_userId` (`userId`),
  KEY `idx_projectId` (`projectId`),
  KEY `idx_action` (`action`),
  KEY `idx_createdAt` (`createdAt`)
);
